FROM Questions Q

JOIN Student_Answers SA ON QI.Question_ID = SA.Question_ID
WHERE SA.Satisfactory_YN = 'Y'
GROUP BY Q.Question_ID, Q.Question_Text
ORDER BY Frequency DESC
LIMIT 1;
